description: Append a signed action to the session's chain. evidence is the structured record of what the agent did or observed; it is hashed and signed. Returns the actionId (use it as attestedActionId for a counterparty attestation).

actionType.description: Short snake_case label for the action (e.g. 'invoice_policy_checked').

evidence.description: Structured evidence for the action (any JSON value). Hashed and signed.

schemaId.description: Override the registered schema for this action (a schema_id). Only used when the session is schema/profile-bound; by default the schema is resolved from actionType. Ignored for freeform sessions.

verifiabilityClass.description: How the evidence can be verified. Defaults to 'deterministic'.

name: sequesign_record_action
title: Record an action
